notes.title: The Lemonade Apocalypse Begins At Steam Next Fest! Demo releases June 6th
notes.content:
We're super excited to share that Lemonade Apocalypse: The Great Filter will be attending Steam Next Fest!

Check out our trailer, if you haven't already
[previewyoutube=cYKBy82XBlA;full][/previewyoutube]

In preparation for the event, we have redesigned the demo page! What do you think?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504300/e9d874ec228d0e745402a84c188ce05240f4eb4e.png

What's the story
A child decides to sell lemonades to afford a new bike. The child quickly realizes that there is a business to be made from this. Thus, a branching story of greed begins and features 27 different endings (for humanity). 

FROM WANTING ONE THING
Tee-hee
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504300/c179c25dd92cb640ee5d278a33376b4aeeacfd50.png

TO WANTING IT ALL
Mwahahahaha
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504300/27b7424c291f2389a6df6f5c157442e6b7e4f712.png

Try Chapter 1 for free this friday! And we would love feedback on it, so let us know what you think in your preferred channel. Discord, Questionnaire, Comments - you decide, we are just happy to hear the likes and dislikes.

Best wishes from the devs at
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504300/50659004adec6c39055d0770ac0530b6687c0dc9.png
